task.prompt: Trace how changing a todo item to done can produce and dispatch a completion notification. Include the trigger condition, event storage, save interception, clearing, and declared notification handler. Does this prove a notification ran after a successful database commit? Cite precise checked-in source ranges and separate configuration from observed runtime behavior.

atoms.requirement: Done emits only on false-to-true transition and then assigns its backing field.
TodoItemCompletedEvent holds the item, derives from BaseEvent, whose INotification contract makes it a MediatR notification.
BaseEntity keeps domain events in a nonmapped read-only exposed collection and AddDomainEvent appends.
Update command handler sets Done and then awaits SaveChangesAsync.

The configured ApplicationDbContext attaches the registered DispatchDomainEventsInterceptor; its SavingChanges and SavingChangesAsync callbacks dispatch before base saving callbacks. This is saving-phase configuration, not evidence of execution after a successful commit.
Dispatcher reads tracked BaseEntity events, materializes them, clears entity collections before awaiting Publish for each.
LogTodoItemCompleted declares INotificationHandler<TodoItemCompletedEvent> and logs its event type; application registers assembly scanning. This does not prove runtime activation.

scoring.correctness: 1: all material clauses correctly explicit, no material contradiction; 0.5: at least one material clause correct and another omitted, no material contradiction; 0: absent or materially wrong
scoring.evidence: 1: precise inspected ranges jointly support every material clause; 0.5: genuine but broad or incomplete support; 0: none or contradictory. Equivalent precise citations and reuse across atoms accepted; evidence can support an omitted clause without automatically double-penalizing correctness omission.
scoring.strict: all atom scores 1; no material unsupported claim; runtime distinction maintained
scoring.runtime: A clear answer-wide source/configuration-versus-runtime distinction suffices; do not require repeated disclaimers per atom. Material runtime overclaims fail strict success.

scope_guards: impact-title-uniqueness compares the two named file roles; update-validator discussion is optional, not required
impact-done-semantics covers selected update/completion path, not exhaustive DTO/client changes; complete URL claims need route-prefix support
No product facts or detector behavior were used to amend the oracle

run_accounting.filesystem_isolation: not enforced; solver can access host workspace
run_accounting.accounting: Each attempted MCP list/call is charged, including native errors. Local CLI syntax errors are separate events, not MCP calls. Complete response bytes include the JSON-RPC envelope. First crossing response is retained and returned, then calls stop. Timer starts at first interaction; coordinator separately records solver spawn and answer times and enforces the full solver deadline.

instructions: Read exact answer and logged displayed evidence. Independently assess each atom against source. Do not equate retained raw response with inspected evidence. Distinguish material unsupported claims from minor citation imprecision. Preserve correct partial credit. Do not inspect product implementation, other reviews, other solver runs or query products.
